data.name: Ratmageddon Underground
data.detailed_description:
Splat your way through infested underground stations, sewers and tunnels overrun by zombified rats. Armed with improvised weapons, deadly traps and a well-aimed foot, help Alan fight his way home on a night he'll wish he could forget.

Ratmageddon is a single-player isometric action-adventure that combines fast-paced combat with environmental puzzles. Explore dangerous underground locations, uncover new routes, solve obstacles blocking your path, and survive relentless swarms of infected rodents.

Discover and wield a growing arsenal of weapons, including a baseball bat, golf club and flamethrower, each offering a different way to deal with the rat infestation. Search each level for useful equipment, manage the dangers ahead, and use quick thinking as well as brute force to stay alive.

Features

- Single-player isometric action-adventure gameplay.

- Battle through underground stations, tunnels and sewers.

- Solve environmental puzzles to progress.

- Find and use a variety of weapons, including a baseball bat, golf club and flamethrower.

- Deploy traps and use your trusty stomp attack to eliminate enemies.

- Fight increasingly dangerous hordes of zombified rats.

- Help Alan survive the Ratmageddon and make it home alive.

⚠️ Please Note: The current demo natively supports Keyboard only. While full controller compatibility will be up and running for our full game. So for now, grab your keyboard and enjoy the demo! 🐀
